item.title: Shooter who killed Brown students and MIT professor planned attack for years, DOJ says
item.description: The man identified as the shooter who killed two Brown University students and an MIT professor planned the attack for years and left behind videos in which he confessed to the murders but gave no motive, according to information released Tuesday by the U.S. Department of Justice.

item.title: Trump says US to get 30 million to 50 million barrels of oil from Venezuela at market price
item.description: President Donald Trump said Tuesday that Venezuela would be providing 30 million to 50 million barrels of oil to the U.S., and he pledged to use proceeds from the sale of this oil “to benefit the people” of both countries.

item.title: Homeland Security plans 2,000 officers in Minnesota for its ‘largest immigration operation ever’
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security said Tuesday that it launched what it described as the largest immigration enforcement operation ever carried out by the agency — with 2,000 federal agents and officers expected in the Minneapolis area for a crackdown tied in part to allegations of fraud involving Somali residents.

item.title: Hoggard handles West Brunswick 63-13
item.description: It was a quick and easy Tuesday for Hoggard girls basketball, opening up conference play with a 63-13 win over West Brunswick.

item.title: Brown drops 30 as New Hanover knocks off North Brunswick 71-59

item.title: Several talking points for the first meeting of the year, for Wilmington City Council
